description: Situated in the heart of Old Town Sausalito, this unique residence offers an exceptional opportunity to enjoy one of Marin's most sought-after waterfront communities. Framed by picturesque views of the bay, San Francisco, and the Bay Bridge, this Sausalito gem presents an opportunity for those with a vision for design and renovation, offering incredible potential to thoughtfully reimagine the current residence or create a dream pied--terre in an unparalleled setting. Just moments from downtown Sausalito's charming Main Street, waterfront pathways, acclaimed restaurants, cafs, boutique shops, art galleries, the Sausalito Boardwalk, and ferry service to San Francisco, the location offers a true vacation at home, blending convenience, character, and scenic beauty. A private and gated pathway leads to the residence and beautiful grounds. The living room features exposed beam ceilings, new carpeting, a wood-burning fireplace with brick surround, and picturesque views spanning the bay, the Bay Bridge, and the San Francisco skyline. The light-filled dining room showcases charming architectural character with exposed beam ceilings, detailed millwork, new carpeting, and picturesque views. Positioned to capture the surrounding scenery, the sunroom features a wall of windows framing views of the bay, the San Francisco skyline, the Bay Bridge, and the hills of Sausalito. The charming kitchen features engineered wood flooring, butcher block countertops, an electric cooktop and oven, and access to the adjacent laundry and utility area with a Whirlpool refrigerator, LG washer, and Samsung dryer. The main-level ensuite bedroom features new carpeting, exposed beam ceilings, and an adjoining bath. The upper level features a flexible office/sitting area with a closet, along with a spacious second bedroom offering vaulted ceilings, a closet, and beautiful views of the bay and San Francisco skyline. A versatile lower-level living space with a private entrance offers flexibility for a home office, den, media lounge, or creative studio. Designed for relaxed outdoor living, the grounds offer a sunny entertainment deck, a lawn, a mature palm tree, yucca trees, fruit trees, and vibrant landscaping surrounded by mature greenery. This premier location in Old Town Sausalito offers a relaxed yet vibrant lifestyle that blends coastal charm, artistic flair, and breathtaking natural beauty. Minutes from the Golden Gate National Recreation Area (GGNRA) with world-class hiking trails.
